fact: The ministry's bulletin for July-September 2023 states that the Health Information Section, with partners, prepared and finalised a five-year costed Health Information Strategy, and that DHIS2 is the exclusive national HMIS platform, with 579 public facilities reporting in the quarter at a 95.8% aggregate reporting rate; the strategy's years and title are not given.
title: Quarterly Health Statistics Bulletin, July – September 2023
publisher: Ministry of Health and Human Services, Federal Government of Somalia
